# Version 4.156.2
> **Filtered image and glyph fixes** · Released November 17, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.156.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.102/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.2 corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering. This servicing release brings Skia m156 fixes for image subsets, image-filter caching and glyph masks without changing managed bindings.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Filtered images stay within their texture subsets** — Corrects sampling under minification, strong skew, antialiased clipping and MSAA so unrelated backing-texture pixels do not leak into filtered images. Image-filter cache-key equality now matches hashing, including distinct floating-point and matrix representations. ([#5773](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5773))
- **Mask-filtered glyphs handle regenerated data safely** — Uses the reloaded glyph's outline, rejects incompatible mask copies and preserves full plane strides when clipping embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes when consecutive glyph loads differ. ([#5742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5742))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.102

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
